-81.36460,28.58360.name: Center for Reproductive Medicine, PA
-81.36460,28.58360.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Randall A. Loy, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

120.11236,32.06345.name: Veterinary Trial Center, Boehringer Ingelheim Vetmedica (China) Co., Ltd.
120.11236,32.06345.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Boehringer Ingelheim Vetmedica (China) Co., Ltd.. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-2.13208,57.15525.name: Aberdeen Fertility Centre
-2.13208,57.15525.state: Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Aberdeen Maternity Hospital, Foresterhill, Aberdeen, AB25 2ZL, Scotland
-2.13208,57.15525.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-46.66535,-23.58143.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.fertility.com.br. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

116.30100,40.18400.name: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention
116.30100,40.18400.state: 155 Changbai Road Changping District, Beijing 102206, China
116.30100,40.18400.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, planned. Run by National Health Commission. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

35.21370,31.76830.name: Israeli fertility system — Ministry of Health
35.21370,31.76830.desc: Israel funds IVF more generously than any other country, with state-covered cycles up to two children and among the highest per-capita treatment rates in the world. It is the closest thing to a natural experiment in what happens when cost stops being the constraint on assisted reproduction.

35.21370,31.76830.name: Cross-border surrogacy and gamete brokerage
35.21370,31.76830.desc: The arrangements through which intended parents obtain eggs, sperm or a surrogate in a country other than their own, chosen because it permits what theirs prohibits. When India, Thailand and Nepal closed to foreign commissioning parents, the trade moved to Ukraine, Georgia and Mexico rather than stopping. Prohibition in one jurisdiction relocates the practice; it does not end it.

-60.63930,-32.94680.name: Bioceres / Moolec — molecular farming
-60.63930,-32.94680.desc: Grows pharmaceutical and animal proteins inside crop plants — pig proteins in soy, bovine proteins in peas. Molecular farming puts a substance intended for a factory into a plant grown in a field, which means containment depends on agronomy rather than on a fermenter wall. It also produces an organism that no category handles cleanly: a food crop that is not food, grown outdoors, regulated as a crop.

-60.63930,-32.94680.name: Bolsa de Comercio de Rosario
-60.63930,-32.94680.desc: Argentina's principal grain exchange, and one of the bodies that opposed the engineered wheat approval alongside the provincial exchanges, the Chamber of Industrial Milling and the farm organisations of the liaison table. The objection was not about eating it. It was that once the engineered variety moves through the same elevators, trucks and ships as the conventional crop, keeping the two apart stops being possible and the value of the conventional crop in export markets goes with it. An exchange exists to price and move grain, so when one argues against a new variety it is arguing about the handling system rather than the biology.
